note: This validation harness requires a live environment with devbob container, SurrealDB, and dashboard running. Execute with: npx playwright test tests/validation-harnesses/activity-execution-comprehensive-mapping-display-harness.ts

successCriteria: Execution ID visible in UI
Template name 'add-rest-endpoint' displayed
Success status icon (green checkmark) present
Duration displayed in seconds or minutes format
Cost displayed with $ prefix and 4 decimal places
Total tokens displayed as formatted number
Task count matches number of tasks in template
Expandable row works correctly
Task breakdown table shows all tasks with status, duration, cost
Impulse usage chips display impulse IDs and types
No data truncation or missing critical fields

validationChecks.expected: Execution ID from SurrealDB matches UI display
add-rest-endpoint
Green success icon
Within 1% of SurrealDB duration_ms
Within 1% of SurrealDB cost_usd
Sum of input/output/cache tokens matches
Matches task_execution table count
All tasks shown in expanded view
Impulse chips match impulses_used field
All fields present and complete

variables.bugDescription: Null pointer exception in user authentication

successCriteria: Failed execution displayed with red error icon
Error message visible in expanded view
Error details panel shows full error text
Failed tasks highlighted with red status chips
Partial task completion reflected (some tasks may succeed before failure)
Duration reflects actual execution time until failure
Cost includes tokens used before failure
Template name displayed correctly
Execution ID visible and unique
All metadata fields present even for failed execution

Error message from SurrealDB shown in expanded view
Failed tasks have red status chips
Some tasks show success, others failed
Duration shows time until error occurred
Cost shows tokens used before failure
Even failed executions show full metadata

successCriteria: Multiple impulse chips displayed in expanded view
Impulse IDs match those used in execution
Impulse types displayed (file, memo, etc.)
Multiple tasks displayed with individual metrics
Task costs sum to total execution cost (within 1% variance)
Task durations sum to total execution duration (within 5% variance due to parallel execution)
All impulse content pointers visible
No impulse data truncation
Expandable sections work smoothly
All numerical values accurate compared to SurrealDB ground truth

Displayed impulse IDs match impulses_used field
Each impulse chip shows type (file/memo)
All tasks shown with individual metrics
Sum of task costs ≈ total execution cost (±1%)
Sum of task durations ≈ total duration (±5% for parallel)
Content pointers shown for each impulse
All impulse data displayed completely

prerequisites: Ensure devbob container is running in local k8s cluster
Verify SurrealDB is accessible at ws://surrealdb.metabob.local:8000
Confirm dashboard is accessible at http://app.metabob.local
Install Playwright if not already installed: npm install @playwright/test
Ensure kubectl context is set to local cluster
Verify activity templates are available on devbob
executionInstructions.expectedDuration: 10-15 minutes total (3-5 minutes per test case)

successCriteria.overall: All test cases must pass (all validation checks return true)
successCriteria.perTestCase: All validation checks within a test case must pass
successCriteria.numericalAccuracy: Numerical values (cost, duration, tokens) must be within 1% of ground truth
successCriteria.visualAccuracy: Status indicators, color coding, and badges must match expected states
successCriteria.completeness: All required fields must be present without truncation

failureAnalysis.ifExecutionIdMissing: Check if GET /analytics/executions endpoint is returning execution data. Verify SurrealDB activity_executions table has the record.
failureAnalysis.ifNumericalMismatch: Verify data transformations in analytics endpoint. Check for rounding errors or unit conversion issues (ms vs s).
failureAnalysis.ifTaskCountWrong: Query activity_tasks table directly to confirm count. Check if ExecutionRow is fetching details correctly.
failureAnalysis.ifImpulsesMissing: Verify impulses_used field is populated in activity_executions. Check if ExecutionRow is parsing impulse data.
failureAnalysis.ifExpandableBroken: Check browser console for JavaScript errors. Verify Material-UI Collapse component is working.
failureAnalysis.ifStatusWrong: Verify success field in activity_executions matches actual execution result. Check icon rendering logic.

debuggingCommands.checkSurrealDBData: kubectl exec -n metabob surrealdb-0 -- surreal sql --conn http://localhost:8000 --user root --pass root --ns metabob --db metabob "SELECT * FROM activity_executions ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 5"
debuggingCommands.checkDashboardLogs: kubectl logs -n metabob $(kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=metabob-dashboard -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
debuggingCommands.checkRPCAPILogs: kubectl logs -n metabob $(kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=metabob-rpc-api -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
debuggingCommands.manualActivityExecution: kubectl exec -n metabob $(kubectl get pods -n metabob -l app=devbob -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- /app/bin/opencode activity execute add-rest-endpoint --var method=POST --var path=/api/test

nextSteps: 1. Ensure all prerequisites are met (devbob running, SurrealDB accessible, dashboard deployed)
2. Execute validation harness: npx playwright test tests/validation-harnesses/activity-execution-comprehensive-mapping-display-harness.ts
